name: Rani Avantibai Lodhi
contribution: Rani Avantibai Lodhi led resistance from Ramgarh in central India after the colonial administration intervened in the estate's affairs during 1857.
context: North and central India during the anti-colonial uprising of 1857-1859.
impact: Her story highlights the role of local sovereignty, estate politics, and women rulers in the regional resistance of 1857.
highlight: Rani Avantibai Lodhi led the Ramgarh resistance during the 1857 uprising in central India.
seoTitle: Rani Avantibai Lodhi: Ramgarh and the 1857 Rebellion
seoDescription: Learn about Rani Avantibai Lodhi's leadership of resistance from Ramgarh during the 1857 uprising.
shortAnswer: Rani Avantibai Lodhi was the queen-regent of Ramgarh who led regional resistance during the 1857 rebellion.
